supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed relative subject of the emphatic clause

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) launches the ayah as a firm assertion, not a loose notice. It governs {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) and holds the later reward predicate {{ar:لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ}} ({{tr:lahum jannātu al-naʿīmi}}) inside one predication, so the promise is syntactically tightened from the first word. Coming after the refusal and warning of 31:6-7, the particle also marks a clean declarative restart: the punishment announcement has closed, and a parallel promise is now stated as settled khabar. Even the compressed opening sound supports that tightening, but its payoff depends on the grammar of the whole clause.

topics.headline: assertion scopes over the whole promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised reward is held inside one emphatic governed proposition from the first word.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) as governing the relative subject and the fronted reward predicate, so the CRITICAL scope claim is locally supported.

topics.headline: warning turns into settled promise

topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah contrast with 31:6-7, and the asyndetic opening with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) can carry that discourse restart without changing the local parse.

topics.reason: The phonetic observation is modest but coherent because it reinforces the particle's attested emphatic and governing role.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) names the rewarded side as a grammatically defined class, not as a lineage or individual. As the governed subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it remains incomplete until the following verbs identify the group: those who believed and worked the sound deeds. Its plural agreement ties both verbs to the same people and prevents the belief clause and action clause from splitting apart. The wording also enters the familiar belief-action formula, so the reward clause answers a recognized identity pattern rather than an isolated description.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines the rewarded group by a relative clause rather than by a proper name or inherited identity.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) the governed subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), with the following relative clause supplying its content.

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the relative group its first defining act as completed commitment. Locally it has no explicit object or bi- complement, so the formula leaves the trust relation open rather than narrowing it to a named object in this word. The root field of {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) keeps belief from being bare cognition: the selected Form IV sense is committed faith with security and trust pressure, while the local frame does not make the subjects people who secure others. Its perfect plural ending also binds it to {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}), so belief begins a paired condition that moves toward the garden reward.

The particle gives the two acts equal syntactic status, so action is not a footnote to belief and belief is not collapsed into action. Because it is pronounced into {{ar:وَعَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:wa-ʿamilū}}), the movement into deeds is quick, yet the conjunction still marks a real hinge from inward commitment to enacted work.

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) is the second perfect plural verb, carrying the same group from belief into outward work. Unlike the objectless belief verb before it, this verb is transitive here and waits for {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) to name the work's moral object. The {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) field makes the act deliberate and result-oriented, while the local Form I frame keeps the subjects as the doers of the deeds themselves rather than employers of others. Its matched plural ending opens into the heavier deed-object, and its position before the reward phrase makes the condition complete enough for {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) to answer it. The same action root returns as a local accountability thread at 31:15, 31:23, and 31:29.

topics.reason: The verb instance is transitive with object word 6, so the CRITICAL valency and definite-object claims are directly licensed.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the object that tells what the believers worked. Its definite plural form treats the deeds as a recognized class, and its active-participle shape has become a substantive noun: the quality of soundness names the deed-category itself. The {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) field keeps the phrase from flattening into vague goodness; these are acts marked by soundness and freedom from disorder. Still, the local form is ṣāliḥāt, not a separate repairer form, so repair and reconciliation remain root pressure rather than the selected morphology. As the last word of the defining clause, it closes the condition before the reward phrase begins, with a firmer sound texture than the light plural verb endings before it. The same definite deed phrase belongs to reward contexts such as 2:25, 4:57, 11:23, 22:14, 29:7, 30:15, and 32:19.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the turn from defining the group to assigning their outcome. Together with {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), it forms fronted {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), the predicate placed before {{ar:جَنَّٰتُ}} ({{tr:jannātu}}). That fronting makes the recipients the hinge: for them, and belonging to them, are the gardens. The lām's possession and benefit values both matter here, because the phrase does not merely locate the reward; it directs and assigns it to the group defined by belief and sound deeds. Against the punishment frame of 31:6, the same kind of assignment now carries reward.

words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتُ}} ({{tr:jannātu}}) is the reward noun, but it arrives only after {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) has foregrounded the recipients. Grammatically it is the delayed nominative subject of the reward clause and the construct head of {{ar:جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ}} ({{tr:jannātu al-naʿīmi}}), so the following genitive defines the gardens by delight. The plural concrete form makes the promise spatial and multiple, not an abstract reward term or undifferentiated greenery. The {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) covering field remains a narrowed payoff: these are gardens/paradise, with enclosure, concealment, and protection pressure still audible. That protected abundance answers the exposed arrogance of 31:7 while also entering the exact paradise formula found in 10:9, 22:56, 26:85, 56:12, and 68:34. The doubled center of the word gives the promised object a compressed weight as it appears.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّعِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-naʿīmi}}) is the final word and the genitive complement that defines the gardens. It does not merely add a decorative adjective; in the construct phrase, delight is grammatically bound to the reward as its quality and what fills it. The definite article makes the bliss recognizable, and the gerund form names a sustained state rather than a countable item. The {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}) field gives the abstract bliss tactile ease, softness, and bestowed favor pressure, while the local word remains {{ar:ٱلنَّعِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-naʿīmi}}), not a single favor. As closure, it lets 31:8 end on ease-filled reward opposite the painful outcome of 31:7, and it joins the recognized bliss formula attested at 10:9, 22:56, 26:85, 37:43, 56:12, and 68:34. The long-vowel cadence of the final phrase lets that blissful closure settle rather than snap shut.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from ءامنوا through عملوا الصالحات to جنات النعيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling security issues in intentional anti-corruptive action; that repair corresponds to a tree-covered habitat whose substance is good condition.

activation_trace.role: Trusted stillness and freedom from fear supply the inward condition that starts the sequence.
Purposeful action converts inward trust into an intended practice.
Opposition to corruption gives those practices a reparative function.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies the repaired and inhabitable outcome.
Good condition and beneficence identify what pervades that habitat.

changed_reading.before: A qualified group receives pleasant gardens as an external reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust becomes intentional repair, and the result is an inhabitable ecology of beneficent good condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الصالحات, the allocation لهم, and جنات النعيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can describe correspondence rather than only payment: fitting acts meet a protective place that fits its inhabitants and affords a good stay.

activation_trace.role: Intended acts are the material whose fitness is tested.
Suitability and fit make righteousness a relational quality, not merely a label.
Protective covering makes the destination a shelter matched to repaired conduct.
A place that agrees with its occupant and gives a pleasant stay completes the correspondence.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are a fixed moral inventory followed by a reward.
changed_reading.after: Righteousness is action made fitting, answered by a fitting protected abode.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عملوا followed by the possessive allocation لهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wage branch of work makes the gardens sound like an allotted return for labor, while the garden and beneficence branches keep the return concrete rather than monetary.

activation_trace.role: A worker's wage supplies an exploratory remuneration frame for the allocation.
Repair rather than labor alone specifies the work that can bear this return.
The return takes the form of a tree-covered dwelling.
Beneficent good condition describes the wage-like return's quality.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are an unspecified gift after deeds.
changed_reading.after: The allocation carries a cautious wage-like undertone: repaired work has a personally assigned return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, growth, and tilling turn the focus sequence into cultivation: purposeful repair is tended until it becomes dense protective vegetation and flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work supplies the cultivator's sustained activity.
Repair supplies what the cultivation does to its field of life.
Thickening and vigorous plant growth render the garden as a matured process.
Gentle direction along a path orients the cultivation rather than leaving action random.
Increase and growth make maintained practice productive.
The farmer who splits and works earth supplies the material cultivation image behind flourishing.

structural_cues: The pre-focus movement passes from guidance through maintained practices to flourishing before the negative contrast of 31:6-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, growth, tilling, repair, and vigorous vegetation; I infer an arrow from guided conduct to cultivated habitat, while a non-causal reward reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are followed by a garden reward.
changed_reading.after: Guided reparative deeds are cultivation whose mature form is sheltered flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blocked-hearing contrast makes faith an open reception that reaches compliance and action, not a private assent left inert.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent is the focus capacity sharpened by the hearing contrast.
Purposeful action shows reception crossing into enacted response.
Diversion supplies the first mechanism that displaces attentive reception.
Turning away supplies the volitional refusal opposed by focus faith.
Understanding that reaches compliance defines the receptive function being denied.
Ear-heaviness materializes the blockage whose removal lets assent become action.

structural_cues: 31:6 and 31:8 repeat لهم for opposed allocations, while 31:7 stands immediately between them as a scene of turning and blocked hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, turning, ear-weight, and hearing-as-compliance; I infer that focus faith is their receptive opposite, while bare propositional assent remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Faith is an internal qualification paired with deeds.
changed_reading.after: Faith is unblocked reception whose truth is its passage into purposeful conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Permanence, promise, and truth distinguish نعيم from brief usable pleasure whose sequel is coercion and roughness; bliss becomes settled reliable good rather than intensified consumption.

activation_trace.role: Softness, luxury, and ease supply the pleasure reading that context temporally discriminates.
Enduring stability removes the possibility that bliss is quickly exhausted.
A spoken promise opening hope grounds the outcome beyond present sensation.
Reality-matching stability secures the promise against illusion.
Enjoyable use supplies the near rival to bliss.
Smallness and scarcity delimit that rival enjoyment.
Compulsion marks the rival enjoyment's forced reversal.
Rough severe treatment supplies the texture opposite to lasting softness.

structural_cues: 31:9 extends the garden state with permanence and a true promise; 31:24 compresses worldly enjoyment and immediately reverses it into harsh constraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal and tactile contrast; I infer that نعيم names a stable category of good unlike brief pleasure, while both can still share immediate delight.

changed_reading.after: Bliss is durable, reality-grounded good that cannot be reduced to brief consumable pleasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A minute deed can remain latent inside a hard enclosure yet be delicately brought forth; garden growth then reads as the mature disclosure of concealed reparative action.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful deed supplies what can begin in a minute and hidden state.
Repair identifies the latent deed's productive quality.
Concealment anchors the latent phase inside the focus garden root.
Dense emerging vegetation supplies the latent phase's mature visible form.
Causing growth supplies the transition from planted potential to vegetation.
A grain capable of sprouting gives the tiny act a generative body.
The mustard grain intensifies minuteness without removing generative potential.
Massive hard rock supplies the apparently sealed enclosure.
Bringing or arrival supplies emergence from the hidden enclosure.
Minuteness, subtlety, and hiddenness explain how the latent grain remains accessible.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the grain in rock, heavens, or earth and then predicates its being brought; 31:10 has already staged caused plant growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, a sprouting grain, minuteness, enclosure, subtle access, and bringing; I infer a maturation arrow from hidden deed to garden habitat, while juridical reward remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an external prize unrelated to the deed's material form.
changed_reading.after: The garden can image the brought-forth and matured ecology latent in even the smallest reparative act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The work-wage reading is revised by gratitude that benefits the same self and by divine independence: the return accrues to the worker without enriching an employer.

activation_trace.role: A worker's wage supplies the remuneration model being revised.
Beneficent good condition supplies the form in which the return accrues.
Recognizing benefit and its giver supplies the action explicitly redirected to its agent.
The thing's own identity fixes the beneficiary as the acting self.
Independence and freedom from need block an exchange that profits the giver.

structural_cues: 31:12 repeats the gratitude verb around لنفسه and then contrasts that reflexive benefit with divine self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive benefit and an independent giver; I infer that لهم marks agent-forming accrual rather than divine need, while a juridical payment metaphor remains available.

changed_reading.before: Gardens are wages paid because the giver benefits from labor.
changed_reading.after: The wage-like return names good accruing to and forming the actor, with no need supplied to the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Righteousness becomes calibrated relation: resist a coercive demand, preserve close companionship in recognized good, and follow a sound way without collapsing those obligations into one another.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action carries the several relational responses into practice.
Removing estrangement keeps refusal from becoming relational destruction.
Suitability makes the right act depend on which relation and demand it answers.
Exertion under pressure supplies the coercive relational force that needs a boundary.
Obedience supplies the response explicitly withheld under that pressure.
Close accompaniment preserves the relationship despite non-obedience.
Recognized good supplies the manner governing continued companionship.
Following behind a way supplies the positive allegiance that replaces wrongful compliance.

structural_cues: Within one ayah, a prohibition of obedience is coordinated with an affirmative command to accompany well and another to follow a different way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, refused obedience, retained companionship, recognized good, and following; I infer relational calibration as the function of صالحات, while the clauses can still be read as separate duties.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are uniformly compliant good acts.
changed_reading.after: Righteousness is fit coordination of boundary, care, and allegiance across competing relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Working members are tuned rather than merely busy: face, gait, and voice are brought toward fit measure, so the softness of bliss echoes a practiced non-rough social texture.

activation_trace.role: Working bodily members activate an embodied rather than abstract account of deeds.
Fit and suitability supply the tuning criterion for bodily conduct.
Softness and ease supply the social texture produced by calibrated conduct.
A face or neck tilted away in pride supplies bodily misalignment.
Walking supplies a repeated bodily field in which action is made visible.
Measure between extremes supplies the gait's tuning principle.
Deliberate lowering by reduction supplies control of vocal force.
Audible voice supplies the final bodily output to be calibrated.

structural_cues: 31:18-19 narrows from orientation of the face to repeated walking language and then to modulation of voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily deviations and controls; I map the focus branch of working members to an embodied tuning mechanism, while the examples may remain illustrative rather than definitional.

changed_reading.before: Good works are externally countable acts, and bliss is passive luxury.
changed_reading.after: Good work includes tuning one's bodily outputs, and bliss's softness becomes the habitat of that practiced fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Complete favor divided into manifest and interior layers expands نعيم beyond sensory comfort; the garden's concealment can itself house unseen beneficence.

activation_trace.role: Positive concealment gives hidden benefit a focus-level spatial anchor.
Completion and full measure make the favor comprehensive rather than decorative.
The repeated benefit root directly reactivates focus bliss as bestowed good condition.
Manifest emergence supplies the benefits available to inspection.
Hidden interiority supplies benefits not exhausted by visible comfort.

structural_cues: 31:20 applies coordinated outward and inward predicates to the plural of the same benefit root used by focus نعيم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete favors explicitly split into outward and inward; I infer that focus bliss includes non-sensory hidden good, while the pair can describe favors generally rather than define the garden.

changed_reading.before: Bliss is chiefly visible and sensory ease.
changed_reading.after: Bliss is comprehensive beneficence with manifest and inward layers, including goods sheltered from view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same geometry of overhead cover can engulf or protect. A wave-canopy threatens enclosure, whereas the garden's covering becomes a shielded habitat reached after separation from danger onto stable land.

activation_trace.role: Cover and concealment supply the geometry shared with the threatening scene.
A protective shield distinguishes beneficial cover from engulfment.
An overlaying cover supplies the wave's engulfing action.
The split mapping's covering image reinforces concealment as the scene's shared material.
Interwoven turbulence makes this cover unstable and threatening.
An overhead canopy gives the threat a garden-like spatial profile.
Salvation by separation supplies the transition out of engulfing cover.
Dry land supplies the stable counter-site from which protective enclosure can be reimagined.

structural_cues: 31:32 first likens waves to overhead canopies and then narrates deliverance to land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat-cover, turbulence, rescue, and land; I infer a reversal from engulfing cover to protective cover, while the maritime scene may remain independent of the garden image.

changed_reading.before: The garden is simply vegetation that hides what is inside.
changed_reading.after: The garden is counter-cover: enclosure transformed from engulfment into stable protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wage-like model survives only under two limits: no parent-child substitution transfers the outcome, and no actor can schedule tomorrow's acquisition or death. The return is personal but not a prosperity calculation.

activation_trace.role: The wage branch supplies the entitlement model being limited.
Parenthood supplies one side of the relationship denied substitution.
Offspring supplies the other side, making the non-transfer rule reciprocal.
Recompense links the prohibition directly to the focus return model.
One thing standing in for another supplies the substitution explicitly denied.
Knowledge supplies the epistemic capacity twice denied to a self.
Acquiring benefit supplies the object that cannot be forecast for tomorrow.
Tomorrow fixes the near horizon at which predictive entitlement fails.
Loss of life fixes the further limit on place and schedule.

structural_cues: 31:33 negates parent-child substitution in both directions; 31:34 repeats لا تدري around tomorrow's acquisition and the place of death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal non-substitution and unknown timing; I infer limits on a wage-like entitlement calculus, while personal recompense itself remains live.

changed_reading.before: Deeds generate a transferable or predictably scheduled entitlement to comfort.
changed_reading.after: The good outcome remains personally attached, but neither kinship nor next-day calculation can substitute for or schedule it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The call-and-response is surprising because it activates form-distant آمين and نعم branches; it remains anchored in the two focus roots and in the intervening work, but downstream prose should present it only as a sonic-semantic undertone, never as an etymological equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ءامنوا and النعيم, with عملوا between them.

activation_trace.role: A request for response in saying amen supplies the opening call.
Purposeful action prevents the call-and-response from bypassing enacted conduct.
Yes and affirmation supply an answering undertone in the named bliss.

changed_reading.before: Faith and bliss are separate qualification and reward terms.
changed_reading.after: A faint request-and-affirmation circuit runs through them, with purposeful work as the enacted middle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The gestational reading is cross-domain and surprising, but the focus root explicitly carries a fetus-hidden-in-the-belly branch and the context adds womb, hidden pregnancy, weaning, and a minute grain. Render it as a contained maturation metaphor, not as a lexical replacement of gardens by wombs or a biological doctrine of reward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جنات through the جنين branch, kept tied to عملوا الصالحات.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful acts supply what the gestational metaphor carries toward maturity.
A fetus hidden in the belly anchors gestational enclosure inside the focus root.
The womb branch gives early contextual support to protected internal development.
Hidden pregnancy or fruit supplies sustained carrying before emergence.
Weaning or separation supplies a maturation boundary after carrying.
A sprouting grain links hidden gestation to eventual garden growth.
The closing return to wombs brackets the surah with unknowable interior development.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the garden is also a protected maturation chamber in which minute reparative acts are carried toward emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it crosses garden material into writing technology, yet 31:27 explicitly makes trees potential pens and replenishes the sea while words do not run out. Keep it as an imagistic echo anchored in the tree-covered focus garden, not as a claim that جنات lexically means text.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جنات as a tree-covered and vigorously vegetated place.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the material later converted into writing instruments.
Abundant plant growth expands the available medium beyond a single tree.
Stemmed trees make the garden's material explicit.
A sharpened writing stick converts arboreal material into inscription.
Vast abundant water supplies the scale of the writing medium.
Ink that supplies a pen makes replenishment specifically scribal.
Failure of exhaustion turns abundance into an inexhaustibility claim.
Meaningful speech gives the inexhaustible garden-material something to disclose.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an abundant place of repose.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, its trees become an inexhaustible medium of disclosure as well as habitat.

strongest_changes: Faith shifted from static assent to receptive trust that becomes action under the blocked-hearing contrast.
Good deeds shifted from a moral inventory to cultivation, latent seed-growth, relational calibration, and bodily tuning.
Bliss shifted from sensory luxury to durable, visible-and-hidden beneficence in a protective habitat.
The wage-like reading survived only as personal reflexive return, not transferable or predictably scheduled entitlement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported several simultaneous material mechanisms: repair growing into habitat, concealment becoming seed-latency or protection, fit becoming relational and bodily calibration, and beneficence dividing into visible and hidden layers. The gestational and tree-pen traces remain deliberately unmerged outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from repaired conduct to cultivated habitat is reader-supplied; the text can retain a juridical reward relation.
The remuneration branch is real activation material but is sharply limited by divine independence, non-substitution, and unknown timing.
The assent-answer, gestational, and inscription readings are branch-valid echoes whose form distance requires explicit qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Trust externalized as reparative work.** **ء م ن B001–B002** supplies settled trust and trusting assent; **ع م ل B001** intentional work; **ص ل ح B001** soundness against corruption and **B002** reconciliation. The coordination of believing and doing makes work the outward operation of security. I infer that trusted order is enacted by repairing what is unsound. The verse reads faith and good deeds as one trust-to-repair mechanism rather than two credentials.
2. **Covered growth as the material form of ease.** **ج ن ن B003** is a tree-covered garden, supported by **B001** covering and **B011** vigorous growth; **ن ع م B001–B002** supplies bestowed well-being and soft ease. The later rain-and-growth scene provides a material relation: covering vegetation is produced abundance that in turn shelters. The causal arrow from cultivation to protected ease is abductive. The gardens thus read as a developed ecology of well-being, not merely a location.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:10 supplied the rain-growth ecology behind the covered garden, and 31:32 showed recognized favor surviving rescue only through fidelity. These later scenes made well-being an actively sustained relation rather than a passive reward-space.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Trust made executable as sound action.** Lexical evidence: `ء م ن B002` is trusting assent and confirmation, `ع م ل B001` is intentional doing, and `ص ل ح B001` is soundness opposed to corruption. Structural cue: faith and work are joined as coordinated completed actions; 31:4 gives their practical grammar, while 31:6-7 show speech and hearing detached from sound response. Assigned role: assent establishes trust, work externalizes it, and soundness qualifies its effect. Abductive move (inferred): confirmation that never crosses into intentional action remains structurally incomplete in this sequence. Reading change: faith reads as a trust that becomes publicly testable through repair-producing work.

2. **The garden as the ecological form of soundness.** Lexical evidence: `ج ن ن B003` is a tree-covered garden, with `ج ن ن B001` contributing protective covering; `ن ع م B001` is pleasant well-being and bestowed favor. Structural cue: 31:10 soon narrates rain, germination, and varied noble growth, while 31:12 frames benefit through gratitude. Assigned role: garden cover materializes the abundant, sheltered condition toward which sound acts point. Abductive move (inferred): the later growth chain activates an ecological analogy between moral repair and a flourishing habitat. Reading change: `جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ` becomes the fitting regenerative environment of repaired action, not an arbitrary prize attached to it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:10's actual rain-to-growth chain made the garden a retrospective ecological image of repaired action. 31:12 then added that grateful reception benefits the self, sharpening bliss as flourishing produced in a sound giver-recipient relation.

baseline.text: İnanıp iyi işler yapanlar için nimet dolu bahçeler vardır.

findings.text: İman, güveni bozulmuş olanı onaran amaçlı işlerde görünür ve sınanabilir hale getirir.
Bahçeler, onarıcı işin karşısına rastgele konmuş bir ödül değil, büyüyen, örten ve koruyan bir esenlik çevresi olarak belirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Near-verbatim counterpart: faith and righteous deeds receive gardens, specifying the promised bliss as Firdaws.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The dispute over Pharaoh's claimed favor does not clarify faith, righteous deeds, or their garden reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It supplies gratitude and divine recompense, but not the focus formula or its garden promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats faith, righteous deeds, and gardens, adding rivers and great success after the closer opening parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate continuation establishes eternal residence and God's true, wise promise for the gardens of bliss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its vision of great bliss expands the reward imagery but lacks the focus's faith-and-deeds condition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins divine judgment with faith, righteous deeds, and gardens of bliss, adding the decisive setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It specifies the believing conduct and certainty in the Hereafter that lead into the focus's promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents enduring gardens as recompense and adds mutual divine pleasure, though its condition differs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It restates faith and righteous deeds with an unceasing reward, clarifying the durability of recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies the God-conscious as being in gardens and bliss, reinforcing the reward state without the action formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its righteous-believer support imagery only loosely relates to the focus's believing community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows faith and righteous deeds yielding divinely bestowed affection, a distinct fruit before the final garden reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby command of gratitude and ethical duty supplies local context for the surah's moral formation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly links faith and righteous deeds to emergence into light and eternal gardens, adding guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes faith a means of divine guidance before gardens of bliss, adding a process absent from the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its enjoyment and protection from punishment portray bliss's contrast but not its qualifying path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The elevated garden is a sparse reward-image parallel with little added condition or explanation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely names gardens of bliss for the God-conscious, supplying a complementary ethical designation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The wise Book is local framing but does not itself clarify the promise in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its blessed water producing gardens offers remote imagery for the garden term, not the promised recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats only the setting of gardens of bliss and adds no condition or outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its exclusive-creation challenge contrasts false worship with the faith required by the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs faith and righteous action with the best recompense and ease, giving a governance-side counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats only gardens of bliss, now highly redundant as a formula parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The humiliating punishment of deniers supplies a broad contrast to the focus's believers' reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nullification of unbelievers' deeds is a contrary outcome, only indirectly sharpening righteous deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats entry into gardens for believers who do righteous deeds and contrasts the unbelievers' end.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local return, reporting of deeds, and knowledge of inner selves explain accountability around the promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its denial of reciprocal human favor does not materially clarify the focus's reward pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It ties gardens of refuge directly to what believers used to do, sharpening the deeds-to-reward connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts the God-conscious entering the garden with greeting and permanence, adding the arrival scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It connects coming as a believer with righteous deeds to the highest ranks, a complementary reward formulation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives blessedness and a good return to those who believe and do righteous deeds, without garden detail.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local description of guidance and mercy for doers of good prepares the same moral category.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes repentance effective through righteous action, clarifying how action belongs to return to God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies believers doing righteous deeds as the best of creation, adding communal evaluation before reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prior divine goodness and distance from punishment are a broad contrast, not a direct reading of the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The objection to abandoning false gods does not clarify the focus's faith, deeds, or reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats believers, righteous deeds, garden companionship, and eternity in a compact close parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding warning against association grounds the faith demanded by the focus in exclusive worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its distinction among righteous and lesser groups is too general to explain the focus's promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins believers doing righteous deeds to the righteous, adding a communal destination rather than gardens.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The eternal-fire outcome for wrongdoers offers only a general contrast to the promised garden.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It affirms that the reward of excellent work is never lost, clarifying why righteous deeds receive recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It adds humble turning to the Lord to faith and righteous deeds, with lasting garden companionship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its diversion from God's path without knowledge is the local contrary pattern to the focus's faithful response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns that association nullifies deeds, sharply defining the boundary that preserves their value.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats an unceasing reward for believers doing righteous deeds but is now largely formulaic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rest, fragrance, and a garden of bliss add sensory contours to the concise promised reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A distress-driven claim of belief contrasts with the settled faith presupposed by the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly states recompense for believers doing righteous deeds and adds forgiveness and noble provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local declaration of guidance and success completes the immediate path leading to the focus's reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Misused oaths and bad deeds are a distant contrast to genuine faith and righteous action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats God's promise of forgiveness and great reward, but adds little after stronger formula parallels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Luqman's commands to pray, promote good, resist wrong, and endure concretize righteous deeds in the surah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to leave affluent deniers does not clarify the focus's conditions or promised garden.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs faith and righteous deeds with a capacity-limited obligation and enduring garden residence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It describes lasting gardens with flowing rivers as recompense for purification, a related qualifying path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its accounting for disbelievers' deeds contrasts with the focus but adds no direct believer-reward link.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It again joins faith and righteous deeds to flowing gardens, emphasizing entry by God's will.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divine signs in ships and the call to patience and gratitude are only broad local ethical background.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies the righteous as in bliss, supplying a concise moral counterpart to the focus's reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts severe punishment with forgiveness and great reward for believers doing righteous deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The distinction between companions of fire and garden is a broad, already familiar outcome contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Witnessing persecution of believers does not clarify the focus's promise to those who believe and act well.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It portrays God's response and increased bounty for believers doing righteous deeds, adding divine surplus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Luqman's wisdom and gratitude provide immediate local grounding for moral responsiveness to God's gifts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Tested striving and undivided allegiance are related faith markers but not a direct reward parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats entrance into eternal flowing gardens and adds the greeting of peace.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local boundary against parental pressure toward association clarifies faithful conduct and final accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The loss of weight by rejected deeds gives a strong contrary boundary for why righteous deeds matter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It adds prayer, almsgiving, safety from fear, and reward with the Lord to the familiar faith-and-deeds formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Creation and generous growth are local divine-sign context, not a direct account of the believers' reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham's request for inheritance of a garden of bliss provides only a prayer-form counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents enduring garden dwellings as the excellent wage of workers, stressing action and recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning against disputing about God without knowledge gives local contrast to informed faith.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The challenge about what discourse they will believe is only a general call to belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts wrongdoers' earned fear with believers' righteous deeds in garden meadows and divine bounty.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sincere devotion in danger is local monotheistic context but does not develop the reward formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins repentance, faith, and righteous action to unwronged entrance into the garden.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats eternal flowing gardens and adds purified companionship and deep shade.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Brief worldly enjoyment followed by punishment is a local contrary outcome with limited explanatory value.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its depiction of former ease is remote reward imagery and lacks the focus's moral condition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It restates eternal flowing gardens as God's true promise for believers doing righteous deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's knowledge of deeds gives local accountability context but no direct reward relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Comprehensive divine knowledge and sight of deeds only broadly support accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats believers' garden entry but chiefly adds adornment rather than interpreting the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local warning that neither parent nor child can compensate on Judgment Day reinforces personal accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The denial that the Qur'an is a poet's speech does not clarify the focus promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The radiance of bliss on faces is a narrow descriptive extension of the reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The reward for excellence and eternal garden residence is a late, general parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Return to the Blaze is only a bare contrary destination.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Gardens and springs are environmental imagery without the focus's faith-and-deeds relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The garden brought near to the God-conscious adds the approach of reward to the focus's promise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It requires repentance, reform, and clarification, offering a concrete model of reparative righteous action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud carving rock in the valley does not add an interpretive connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The prohibition of betraying God and trusts gives a concrete ethical expression of faithful righteous conduct.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promise of divine help does not clarify the focus's garden reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It separates each party's deeds and responsibility, clarifying the accountability implicit in deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding rejection of recited signs is the local contrary response to the faith rewarded in 31:8.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely joins faith and righteous deeds to gardens, with enduring residence and recurring provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly makes faith and faithful action a condition for God's admission into flowing gardens.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies the successful believers as inheritors of Firdaws, a precise counterpart to the focus's garden reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that believers who do righteous deeds will be made joyful in a garden.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly joins faith in God and righteous action to entry into gardens with flowing rivers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It promises full recompense to those who believe and do righteous deeds, clarifying the reward relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It declares that no worker's deed is lost and promises gardens, reinforcing action-based recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes believing righteous action the condition for entering the garden without injustice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It connects faith and God-consciousness to expiation and gardens of bliss for another community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents gardens as God's recompense for faithful speech, adding a concrete response of belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts the garden as inherited by those who were guided and acted, extending the nearby garden parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives believers divine good news of mercy, pleasure, and gardens of lasting bliss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly promises believing men and women gardens of lasting residence and divine pleasure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents prepared eternal gardens as the successful outcome for believers who answer God's call.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins divine pleasure with prepared flowing gardens and eternal residence for the foremost believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It adds that the righteous enter eternal gardens with righteous family, expanding the communal horizon of reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names eternal gardens and enduring provision as the return for the God-conscious.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It announces a great reward to believers who do righteous deeds, a direct non-garden counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It frames gardens of Eden as the Merciful's promised, unseen reward to His servants.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs faith and righteous deeds with forgiveness and noble provision, a close reward formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows repentance, faith, and righteous action transforming evil deeds, expanding the restorative force of righteous action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gathers believing and righteous dispositions under God's forgiveness and great reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links gardens of Eden with the righteous among believers and their families in the final destination.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts believers entering the garden in joy, adding a communal arrival scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It promises believing men and women eternal flowing gardens and the removal of their wrongs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows believing men and women receiving light and good news of flowing gardens on the final day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents a vast garden prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins divinely strengthened faith with entrance into eternal flowing gardens.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes faith and striving lead to forgiveness and gardens of lasting residence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives repentant believers a final-day garden promise, adding repentance to faithful moral response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It promises believers who do righteous deeds their full rewards and added bounty from God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It extends faith in God and the Last Day with righteous action to a no-fear, no-grief outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links faith, righteous deeds, and God-consciousness in a concrete moral-legal setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes God's mercy the destination for those who believe and do righteous deeds.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Security is produced by enclosure, permanence, binding, and exact construction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Garden, promise, and truth converge as different forms of protected space and fitted construction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Garden as Covered Refuge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Assent opens into security, and a covered garden becomes a shielding enclosure of good condition and permanence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; assent `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; covering or concealment `quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`; tree-covered garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; protective shield `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; good condition or bliss `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; permanence `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 31:8 ءَامَنُ (ء م ن), جَنَّٰتُ (ج ن ن), and نَّعِيمِ (ن ع م); 31:9 خَٰلِدِينَ (خ ل د).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belief and safety occupy the same lexical frame, while the garden is first an enclosure made by covering vegetation and then a shield. Bliss names the condition inside that enclosure, and permanence prevents the refuge from becoming temporary shelter.

channel_generated_outputs.usage: External source manifest only. These generated outputs may inform channel-family/path context when the agent has file access, but first-pass review limits still apply: no established channel name, accept/reject claim, or maturity claim unless a future adjudicated ledger is present.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem guven halini hem de guvenilirlik ve emanet iliskisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun giderilmesi ve ic yatiskinligi onde oldugunda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Korku karsiti guven halini korur.
error_profile.loses: Emanet, guvenilirlik ve guven verme boyutlarini disarida birakir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin baskasini koruma ve teminat altina almasi anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir baskasina guven saglama iliskisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Guven icinde bulunma ve guvenilirlik adlandirmalarini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisi, emanet ya da dayanikli nesne guvenilirlik niteliginde anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Guvenilir sayilma ve emanet edilebilir olma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Korkudan emin olma halini ve guven verme eylemini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Guvenlik, korkunun kalkmasi, emanet ve guvenilirlik alanlarini kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir haberin, vaadin veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasi alanini kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisinde de kalbin yatismasi ve guven hissi bulunabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Korku karsiti guvenligi, guven vermeyi ve emanet iliskisini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir seye alisma, yakinlik duyma ve ona icten dayanma tarafini one cikarir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kalbin bir seye karsi yatismasi ve guven duymasi vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal ic yakinlik ve dayanma tarafinda yogunlasir; bu dal ise korkusuzluk, teminat ve guvenilirlik kurumunu da semantik cekirdege alir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nefis, aile veya kalp genisligi ve sakin mizac alaninda durur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haber veya sozun dogrulanmasi anlatildiginda en dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdik cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dini boyun egme ve davranisla baglanma tarafini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini ve icten kabullenme baglamlarinda tasdikten daha genis sureci aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdikle birlikte ic kabul ve baglanma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sade haber tasdiki icin fazla agir ve ozel kalir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vaat edilen seyin gercek ve guvenilir kilinmasi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Vaatle ilgili dogrulama tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tasdik ve dini kabullenme alanlarini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu, canlı bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem olarak kurar. İyi ve kötü davranış örnekleri bu çekirdeğin ahlaki alanlara da uygulanabildiğini gösterir; ücret, görev, karşılıklı işlem veya özel adlar bu kola ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, bilinçli yapılan iş ve eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret, resmi görev, karşılıklı alışveriş ve nesne ya da beden parçası adları ayrı kollardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın iş anlamı hem de belirli kalıplı kullanımlar vardır; tanım yalın çekirdeği verir, kalıplı örnekleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Canlı bir yapanın bilerek gerçekleştirdiği iş veya eylemdir; iyi ya da kötü davranışları da kapsayabilir. Kendisi için çalışmak ya da işe yoğun biçimde girişmek bu çekirdeğin özel kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
İyi ve kötü davranışlar da bilinçli eylem alanı içinde yer alır.
Kişinin kendisi için çalışması veya işe dalması bu çekirdeğin özel bir görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı canlı bir yapanın bilinçli biçimde yaptığı iş veya eylem olarak toplar; bu kapsam iyi ve kötü davranış örneklerine de uygulanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bilinçli yapma ve iş görme çekirdeğini karşılar; ahlaki iyi veya kötü davranış bağlamlarında da kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinçli yapma, iş görme ve davranış kapsamını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, başkasını çalıştırma, birinden iş isteme ve görüş, söz, mızrak, yapı malzemesi veya zihin gibi şeyleri kullanma örneklerini aynı işe koşma alanında toplar. Bu, genel iş yapma değil, bir şeyi veya birini işlevde kullanma anlamıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki kalıplı kullanımı birlikte verir: hayvanın ayakları ve uzağı gören göz. Bunlar tek bir yalın organ adı değildir; kol ancak iş gören beden parçası fikriyle, kalıplı kullanımların sınırı açık tutulursa korunabilir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durum olarak kurar; ayrıca bu duruma gelmeyi, bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi ve belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranmayı da kapsar. Geçici çerçeve bu durum, süreç ve ettirgen işlem ayrımlarını doğru biçimde bir arada tutmaktadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kişiler, işler ve şeylerdeki iyi durum ile bu durumu sağlama bu dala girer; kişiler arası uzlaşma, uygunluk ve özel adlar ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimlerdeki iyi ve düzgün olma çekirdeğini, düzeltme türevlerini ve yalnızca belirli yapıda görülen iyi davranma kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durumdur. Bu eksen kişinin ve işin iyi olmasını, bir şeyi düzeltmeyi, yarar sağlayan şeyi, iyi duruma getirmeyi istemeyi ve özel bir yapıda hayvana iyi davranmayı kapsar; insanın iyi yaratılması, bozukluğunun giderilmesi veya iyi sayılması da düzeltmenin farklı gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uzaklık ve soğukluğun giderilmesini karşılıklı barışma ve uzlaşmayla açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu kişiler arası sınırı korur ve genel anlamdaki iyi olma ya da bir nesneyi düzeltme anlamını bu dala taşımadığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanlar arasındaki soğukluk, çatışma veya uzaklığın barışmayla giderilmesini kapsar; genel düzgünlük ve nesne onarımı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın kişiler arası barışma çekirdeğine dayanır ve başka dallardaki genel iyi olma, düzeltme veya uygunluk anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluk, uzaklık veya çatışmanın giderilerek tarafların karşılıklı biçimde barışması ve uzlaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı insanların kendi aralarında barışması ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir; ad ve eylem biçimleri aynı karşılıklı uzlaşma olayını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. Geçici çerçeve uygunluk ilişkisini doğru saptamış ve ahlaki iyilik ya da bozukluğu düzeltme anlamlarını bu dala katmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca verilen kişi yönelimli yapıda bir şeyin o kişiye uymasıdır; yalın bir iyi olma veya genel düzeltme anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun olduğunu bildiren kalıba bağlıdır; bu kullanım yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi genişletilemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı örtme, duyulardan gizleme ve bir örtünün arkasına saklanma çekirdeğinde kurar; içte saklama ile insanı örten giysi de bu çekirdeğin açık gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örtme ve gizlenme alanındadır; akıl yitimi, bahçe ve görünmeyen varlık anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı kapsar ve başka dallara ya da yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi duyuların erişiminden çıkaracak biçimde örtmek ya da gizlemek; kişinin bir şeyin arkasına saklanması, bir şeyi içinde saklaması ve insanı örten giysi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey örtülerek ya da gizlenerek duyuların erişiminden çıkarılır.
Bir örtünün arkasına saklanma, bir şeyi içinde saklama ve insanı örten giysi aynı gizleme çekirdeğine dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni, bir şeyi duyusal algıdan örterek gizlemek ve bu örtünün sağladığı saklılık durumudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin örtülmesini, bir kişinin saklanmasını veya örtü işlevli bir şeyi birlikte temsil eden en geniş karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini, duyulardan gizlenme sonucunu ve dalın genel kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir öznenin nesneyi görünmez veya algılanamaz duruma getirdiği geçişli kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçişli örtme eylemini ve bunun doğurduğu gizlenme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir örtü veya engel aracılığıyla kendini duyulardan sakladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtü aracını ve öznenin kendisini algıdan saklaması anlamını birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: örtmek; gizleyecek bir örtü sağlamak; içinde saklamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, duyulardan saklanmayı, içte gizlemeyi ve insanı örten giysiyi aynı çekirdekte toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, örtü ve örtme araçlarının genel söz varlığını daha doğrudan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi örtme ve böylece görünmesini engelleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu sonucu duyusal erişimden gizlenmedir; komşu dal ise genel örtme ve kaplama alanını daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını genel örtme dalı sağladığı için yalnızca bu ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ستر الشيء عن الحس والاستتار بشيء وإكنان الشيء في الصدر وما يواري من ثوب أو غيره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجنون ولا الجنة ولا الجن
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجيم والنون أصل واحد وهو الستر والتستر (maqayis)؛ أصل الجن ستر الشيء عن الحاسة (mufradat)؛ استجن فلان إذا استتر بشيء (ayn;tahdhib)؛ أجننت الشيء في صدري أكننته (sihah)؛ ما علي جنان إلا ما ترى أي ثوب يواريني (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca gecenin kararıp bir şeyi karanlığıyla örtmesini bildirir; dalın gece karanlığı ile örtme işlemini birlikte tutan çerçevesi buna uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sırf gece, sırf karanlık veya güneşin batması yeterli değildir; karanlığın bir şeyi örtmesi kurucudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı verir; başka gece sözlerine veya insan topluluğu ve iç dünya anlamlarına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Gecenin kararması ve bir şeyi kendi karanlığıyla örterek görünmez kılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Gece kararır ve karanlığı bir şeyin üzerini örter.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gecenin kararmasını, bu karanlığın nesneleri örtüp görünmez kılmasıyla birlikte anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gece karanlığının bir kişi, yer veya nesneyi kaplayıp görünmez kıldığı bütün yalın kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geceyi, kararma sürecini ve karanlığın örtücü sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yerin veya nesnenin gece bastığında karanlık içinde görünmez hale geldiği anlatımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Gecenin bastırmasını ve nesnenin karanlıkla örtülmesini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gecenin koyu karanlığı ve nesneleri örtmesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda gece karanlığı yalnızca artmaz, aynı zamanda bir şeyin üzerini örter.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gecenin karanlık hale gelmesini örtülen bir nesne şartı olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gecenin karanlıklaşması ve yoğun karanlık alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu için kararma yeterliyken odak dalda karanlığın bir kişi, yer veya nesneyi örtmesi anlamın kurucu parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün gece, ışık ve aynı kökten gelen dal adayları değerlendirildi; örtme koşulunu en iyi sınayan kararma dalı yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جن الليل على الشيء إذا أظلم وستره بسواده
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس سواد الناس ولا الجنان بمعنى القلب
branches.source_phrase_ar: جنان الليل سواده وستره الأشياء (maqayis)؛ أجنه الليل وجن عليه الليل إذا أظلم حتى يستره بظلمته (ayn)؛ جن عليه الليل يجن بالضم جنونا (sihah)؛ جن عليه الليل وأجنه الليل إذا أظلم حتى يستره بظلمته (tahdhib)؛ جنه الليل وأجنه وجن عليه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bahçeyi ağaçları veya hurmalıkları toprağı örten ağaçlı bir yer olarak tanımlar; dalın ağaç örtüsünü merkeze alan çerçevesi kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her çevrili alan veya her ekili toprak bu dala girmez; ağaçlı bahçe ve ağaçların örttüğü zemin esastır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ağaçlı bahçe anlamını taşır ve ölüm sonrası ödül yurdu ya da genel bitki örtüsü anlamını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Ağaçları, özellikle de sık ağaç veya hurmalıkları zemini örten bahçe ya da koruluk niteliğindeki yerdir.

facets.statement: Ağaçlı bahçenin zemini ağaçların oluşturduğu örtü altında kalır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı bahçe, ağaçlı bahçe ve hurmalık çevresinde birleştirir; ayırt edici özellik ağaçların zemini örtmesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ağaçların veya hurmalıkların yoğunluğu sayesinde zemini örtülen bahçe ve koruluklar için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bahçe türünü, ağaç varlığını ve zeminin bu ağaçlarla örtülmesi koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam zeminin ağaçlarla örtülü olduğunu zaten gösterdiğinde doğal ve kısa bir çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaçlarla kaplı bahçe referansını bağlam desteğiyle eksiksiz korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: zemini ağaçlarla örtülü bahçe veya koruluk

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bahçeyi ağaçların zemini örtmesiyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bahçeyi çevresindeki duvar, engel veya yükseltiyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ağaç veya bitki içeren sınırlı bir bahçe alanına gönderimde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta içteki ağaç örtüsü, komşuda ise alanı dıştan kuşatan sınır belirleyicidir; bu yüzden sıradan bağlamda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün bahçe, hurmalık, bitki ve aynı kökten dal adayları değerlendirildi; dış sınır ile ağaç örtüsü karşıtlığı en yararlı ayrımdır.
